## Purpose and Entrypoints
LiteParse is a local-first document parser centered on spatial PDF extraction, optional OCR, and text/Markdown/JSON output with bounding boxes. The Rust core provides the `lit` CLI and library API; Node, Python, and WASM expose the same core capabilities.
- Core/CLI: `crates/liteparse/src/lib.rs`, `crates/liteparse/src/main.rs`
- Package façades: `packages/node/src/cli.ts`, `packages/python/liteparse/cli.py`, `crates/liteparse-wasm/src/lib.rs`

## Input Normalization and PDF Runtime
Parsing begins by accepting PDFs directly or converting office/image input to PDF. Conversion is an infrastructure boundary: LibreOffice handles office formats and ImageMagick handles images, installed externally rather than embedded.
- Conversion orchestration: `crates/liteparse/src/conversion.rs`
- PDF integration layers: `crates/pdfium/src/lib.rs`, `crates/pdfium-sys/src/lib.rs`, `crates/pdfium-sys/src/dynamic.rs`
PDFium is the native rendering, text, font, and document-access dependency; dynamic loading/FFI isolates it from parser logic.

## Extraction, Rendering, and Complexity Routing
The parser opens PDF pages through PDFium, extracts positioned native text and document structure, and can render page bitmaps for OCR or screenshots. A lightweight inspection path detects scanned, sparse, garbled, image-heavy, or vector-text pages before full parsing.
- Pipeline coordinator: `crates/liteparse/src/parser.rs`
- Native extraction: `crates/liteparse/src/extract.rs`
- Rendering/screenshots: `crates/liteparse/src/render.rs`
- Complexity analysis: `crates/liteparse/src/search.rs`

## OCR Boundary and Merge Stage
OCR is selective and configurable: built-in Tesseract is the default local engine, while an HTTP adapter calls compliant external OCR services. OCR receives rendered page imagery and returns text, confidence, and boxes; merge logic reconciles OCR with PDF-native extraction before layout projection.
- OCR abstraction/adapters: `crates/liteparse/src/ocr/mod.rs`, `crates/liteparse/src/ocr/tesseract.rs`, `crates/liteparse/src/ocr/http_simple.rs`
- Result reconciliation: `crates/liteparse/src/ocr_merge.rs`
- External API contract and sample services: `OCR_API_SPEC.md`, `ocr/easyocr/server.py`, `ocr/paddleocr/server.py`
Tesseract data can be supplied through `TESSDATA_PREFIX`; HTTP OCR is the principal remote-service boundary.

## Spatial Reconstruction and Markdown Semantics
Merged glyph/text geometry is projected into reading order and layout regions. The Markdown layer then applies deterministic heuristics for block classification, headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, inline content, repeated elements, and cross-region ordering.
- Geometry projection: `crates/liteparse/src/projection.rs`
- Figure grouping: `crates/liteparse/src/figure_cluster.rs`
- Markdown layout engine: `crates/liteparse/src/markdown_layout/mod.rs`, `crates/liteparse/src/markdown_layout/tables.rs`, `crates/liteparse/src/markdown_layout/cross_region.rs`
Font/CMap and glyph resolution support reliable recovery of encoded PDF text.

## Output Model and Formats
The core carries structured document/page/text/bounding-box types through parsing, then serializes or renders them as JSON, layout-preserved text, or reconstructed Markdown. Markdown may retain links and emit, suppress, or extract images.
- Shared types/configuration: `crates/liteparse/src/types.rs`, `crates/liteparse/src/config.rs`
- Output boundary: `crates/liteparse/src/output/mod.rs`, `crates/liteparse/src/output/json.rs`, `crates/liteparse/src/output/markdown.rs`

## Distribution Runtimes
Rust bindings wrap the core rather than reimplementing the pipeline: napi-rs serves Node native modules, PyO3 serves Python, and wasm-bindgen targets browser/WASM with platform stubs. CLI packaging is replicated by Node/Python wrappers so users invoke `lit` consistently.
- Node binding: `crates/liteparse-napi/src/lib.rs`, `packages/node/src/lib.ts`
- Python binding: `crates/liteparse-python/src/lib.rs`, `packages/python/liteparse/parser.py`
- WASM binding: `crates/liteparse-wasm/src/lib.rs`, `crates/liteparse-wasm/src/wasi_stubs.rs`
